verdict.rationale: The machine-payments docs say agent payments land in the Stripe balance with refunds available through the standard Refunds API and Dashboard. Agent orders flow through standard Stripe rails (checkout.session.completed events, PaymentIntents with agent_details, x402 payments recorded as PaymentIntents), so they are refundable objects. The MCP server also names refunds as agent write actions that require human approval. However, the ACS seller and agent checkout docs never describe refund initiation or status tracking for agent-placed orders. Missing for 10: explicit ACS refund flow documentation, refund status webhooks or tracking for agent orders, refund handling in the custom ACP/third-party-processor integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
